questions.question: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: At standard atmospheric pressure (sea level), water boils at 100°C.

questions.question: Humans have four lungs.
questions.explanation: Humans have two lungs — a left and a right.

questions.question: The Sun is a star.
questions.explanation: The Sun is a medium-sized star at the centre of our solar system.

questions.question: Sound travels faster than light.
questions.explanation: Light travels at about 300,000 km/s; sound travels at about 343 m/s in air. Light is far faster.

questions.question: Plants produce oxygen during photosynthesis.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water to produce glucose and oxygen.

questions.question: Earth is the largest planet in the solar system.
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet. Earth is the fifth largest.

questions.question: Diamonds are made of carbon.
questions.explanation: Diamond is a form of pure carbon, arranged in a crystal lattice.

questions.question: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
questions.explanation: Lightning frequently strikes the same tall structures repeatedly — the Empire State Building is struck about 25 times a year.

questions.question: An adult human body has 206 bones.
questions.explanation: Adults have 206 bones. Babies are born with about 300, many of which fuse together.

questions.question: All bacteria are harmful to humans.
questions.explanation: Many bacteria are beneficial — gut bacteria aid digestion, and others are used to make cheese and yoghurt.

questions.question: The human brain uses about 20% of the body's oxygen.
questions.explanation: Though the brain is only about 2% of body weight, it consumes roughly 20% of the body's oxygen and energy.

questions.question: Glass is a liquid at room temperature.
questions.explanation: Glass is an amorphous solid. The "flowing glass" idea is a myth — old windows thicken at the bottom from manufacturing, not flow.

questions.question: Sound can travel through a vacuum.
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium (air, water, solid) to travel. In a vacuum there are no particles to carry the vibrations.

questions.question: Dolphins are fish.
questions.explanation: Dolphins are mammals — they breathe air, give birth to live young, and produce milk.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is Au.
questions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word "aurum", meaning gold.

questions.question: An octopus has three hearts.
questions.explanation: An octopus has three hearts — two pump blood to the gills, one pumps it to the rest of the body.

questions.question: The North Pole is a continent.
questions.explanation: The North Pole is floating sea ice, not land. The South Pole is on the continent of Antarctica.

questions.question: Sharks are mammals.
questions.explanation: Sharks are fish — they have gills, lay eggs (or give birth to live young), and are cold-blooded.

questions.question: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
questions.explanation: Mercury is the innermost planet, orbiting the Sun at about 58 million km.

questions.question: About 60% of the adult human body is water.
questions.explanation: The average adult body is roughly 60% water. The brain and heart are around 73% water.
